input:
cd /hutian/repo; cat > /tmp/i.md <<'E'
Venue check on the `dev` build (`built-from` d76146b24b7d, 11 pages): one finding against the venue's font rule; everything else I could check passes so far.

**Type 3 font in the PDF.** NeurIPS 2026 sends back PDFs with Type 3 fonts. `pdffonts` lists one, `F53` at 9.96 pt, on pages 1, 4, 7, 8, 9 and 10. The text set in it is `\texttt` text: "email" (p. 1), "seed 0" (p. 4), and the URL "https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy" (p. 7). I read this from the PDF with PyMuPDF. The cause is probably that T1-encoded Computer Modern typewriter has no Type 1 outline in this TeX installation, so TeX embeds bitmaps. I have not tested a fix.

Suggested fix, in `paper/main.tex` and not in the style file: load a Type 1 monospace family after the style, e.g. `\usepackage{lmodern}` or `\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}` with `\usepackage{inconsolata}` (or `\usepackage{courier}`), or set the `\texttt` text in a font that has outlines. Then check with `pdffonts document.pdf | grep -c 'Type 3'`, which must print 0. Figures drawn by `figtab-repo` must also carry no Type 3 font (`pdf.fonttype = 42`). The check must be repeated on the final PDF.

**Other checks on this build (draft, so provisional):**
- US Letter, 11 pages. The References heading is on p. 3 and the checklist heading on p. 5, so the main text is within 9 pages for now. The Experiments section is still empty, so this will change.
- All other fonts are embedded Type 1.
- The kit files must stay unmodified (`paper/neurips_2026.sty`, `paper/checklist.tex` with only the answers filled in).
E

shown.message:
I checked the `dev` PDF against the NeurIPS font rule and found one violation, which I reported to `paper-repo` as `paper-repo`#5. I haven't tested the fix.

- **Violation:** the PDF contains one Type 3 font, which NeurIPS sends back for repair. It appears on pages 1, 4, 7, 8, 9 and 10. It is `\texttt` text: "email" on page 1, "seed 0" on page 4, and a URL on page 7.
- **Likely cause and fix:** the typewriter font probably has no Type 1 outlines in this TeX installation. The issue suggests loading a Type 1 monospace family in `paper/main.tex`, not touching the style file. The check afterwards is that `pdffonts document.pdf | grep -c 'Type 3'` prints 0. The same check has to be repeated on the final PDF.
- **Everything else I could check passes for now:** US Letter size, the other fonts embedded as Type 1, and the page positions below. References start on page 3 and the checklist on page 5, so the main text is within 9 pages. That will change once the Experiments section is written.
- **Outline:** revisions 9–10 of the outline (the outcomes of the pre-fixed analysis rules, and a not-run list) don't touch the venue requirements, so `VENUE.md` is unchanged.
